title: Aerial View of Snorkeling in Maldives

source.author: addhu maldives
source.edits: Pillarboxed to 1280x720, 30 fps playback (full vertical frame scaled to 405x720, centred on black bars, no crop); hand-annotated recording, not a SAM run

scene.gsdSource: Hand estimate: a ~1.5 m shark spans ~45 px in the padded 1280x720 frame (±30%); no reference object in frame, so scale is rough
scene.notes: Hand-annotated, not a SAM run. Pillarboxed playback: the full vertical 1080x1920 frame is scaled to 405x720 and centred on black bars in 1280x720 (no crop). Centre is a Maldives-area placeholder offshore point for the map only; the Pexels page gives no verified filming location, so this is NOT the real location. Top-down drone, slowly rotating, over a snorkel tour with 3 boats and ~15-20 snorkelers; several small shark-like silhouettes swim among the snorkelers near the main boat's stern. Species cannot be identified from these frames. Tracks follow the stern-group sharks; in a rotating group, individual identity cannot be guaranteed across the whole clip, so confidence is 0.60 and later, more ambiguous silhouettes were dropped rather than guessed.
